subject: how to specify both Rasch and PCM item parameters in generate.mirt_object?

messages.author: d441408e1bd05e38
messages.subject: how to specify both Rasch and PCM item parameters in generate.mirt_object?
parts:
I have  two Rasch and two PCM item parameters estimated from Winsteps. One of the PCM items is a 4 point item and the other is a 2 point item. How to specify the parameters in the function 'generate.mirt_object' so that I can generate a mirt object?

the difficulty values for the two Rasch items are -1 and 1
the step values for the two PCM are 
-2.53, - 0.82, -0.08, 1.48
-1.33, 0.13

below is the proper way to specify the parameter data.frame?

pars <- data.frame(a1 = rep(1, 4), 
                   d1 = c(-1, 1, -2.53, -1.33),
                   d2 = c(NA, NA, -0.82, 0.13),
                   d3 = c(NA, NA, -0.08, NA),
                   d4 = c(NA, NA, 1.48, NA)
                   )
mod <- generate.mirt_object(pars, itemtype = 'Rasch')

Thanks

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: how to specify both Rasch and PCM item parameters in generate.mirt_object?
parts:
For Rasch models isn't it just the case that the sign of the intercepts are multiplied by -1? You could also try the traditional2mirt() function built into the package to translate more traditional IRT parameterizations to the slope intercept form used in the package. 

Phil
